newsitem.title: TAIWAN: EVA, Bell Helicopter in military maintenance deal.
newsitem.headline: EVA, Bell Helicopter in military maintenance deal.

text.p: EVA Airways, a unit of Taiwan shipping giant Evergreen Marine, said on Monday it would join a T$27 million military maintenance project with Bell Helicopter Textron Inc of the United States.
EVA and Bell Helicopter would install night vision image systems for the army's 12 U.S.-made, UH-1H transport helicopters, an EVA spokesman said by telephone.
Bell Helicopter Textron is a subsidiary of Textron Inc.
"This is the first time for the military and EVA. It means the private sector will be able to participate in the military's high-technology maintenance projects," the spokesman said.
"It opens a new business opportunity for the company."
